ui.model_opacity_hint: model opacity — drag left for an x-ray view

mode.auto_h: the planner decides: CAD for technical parts, mesh/hybrid for organic shapes
mode.cad_h: parametric build123d code only — precise, dimension-true parts
mode.mesh_h: image → generated mesh — organic/sculptural shapes (needs ≥1 image + mesh server)
mode.hybrid_h: generated organic mesh + exact CAD features on top (needs ≥1 image + mesh server)
mode.topopt_h: base part + topology optimization — organic lightweight structure, FEM-verified (describe loads in the prompt)
mode.mesh_down: mesh server unreachable — mesh & hybrid modes are unavailable.
mode.need_image: needs at least one reference image — otherwise the run falls back to CAD.
mode.auto_down: mesh server unreachable — auto mode will only use CAD.
mode.topopt_hint: describe loads & fixtures in the prompt (e.g. "fixed at the holes, 100 N on top") — the agent picks the base geometry, then optimizes it.

opt.title: Options
opt.fem_check_h: run FEM structural analysis after generation
opt.topopt_check_h: topology-optimize the part (SIMP; generates a topopt version)
opt.fem_note_ph: loads & fixtures (optional) — e.g. 'fixed at M4 holes, 100 N on top face'

asset.drop_pre: Drop reference images / STEP / STL / DXF here, or
asset.empty_hint: Images help the agent understand shape and features.
asset.sketch_hint: marked as sketch — feeds the sketch-conditioned mesh adapter
asset.vary_hint: AI variation / edit with this image as reference

ed.title: Edit image
ed.err_empty: selection is empty — paint or lasso the area to keep first
ed.busy_bg: removing background… (first run downloads the u2net model, ~170 MB)
ed.hint_crop: drag a rectangle — corners resize, inside moves
ed.hint_brush: paint the region to keep — then “keep selected”
ed.hint_lasso: click points, double-click or “close selection” to finish

gen.ref_hint: optional — pick an asset to vary or edit it (img2img / instruction edit)
gen.prompt_hint: what should the reference show — subject, view, style
gen.edit_hint: what to change — e.g. "make it matte black", "add cooling fins"
gen.prompt_ph: e.g. a wall-mounted headphone holder, three-quarter view, studio light
gen.edit_ph: e.g. turn this into a clean black-and-white sketch
gen.strength_hint: how much to change the reference (low = stay close, high = strong change)
gen.sketch_note: Mark result as sketch — feeds it to the sketch-conditioned mesh adapter (TripoSG-scribble)
gen.no_adapter: no image adapter reported by the mesh server — install one (see docs/image-generation)
gen.no_edit_adapter: no edit-capable image adapter available — qwen-image-edit is the default choice on Apple Silicon (see docs/image-generation)
gen.slow_note: local generation can take a moment — the model loads on first use

err_unreachable: server unreachable — is the stack running? (make status)

viewer.measure: measure distance — click two surface points (Esc exits)
viewer.context_lost_hint: the graphics context was reset — reload the view to continue

error_boundary.title: Something went wrong
error_boundary.hint: The view crashed unexpectedly. Your work is saved — you can retry or reload the app.
